caption:
Justice, kindness, family: three things Allah commands

In one verse, Allah enjoins justice, kindness and giving relatives their dues, and forbids shameful acts, evil deeds and oppression. He exhorts us so that we may take heed. Before the weekend, choose one of the three to act on.

Surah An-Nahl 16:90

Which of the three will you act on before Friday ends?

#justiceandkindness #familyties #surahnahl #quranreels

Recitation: Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais
